name: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Limited
summary: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Limited, together with its subsidiaries, research, develops, manufactures, and sells generics, specialty medicines, and over the counter (OTC) pharmaceutical products in India, North America, Europe, and internationally. The company provides various products in the therapeutic areas of dermatology, respiratory, oncology, cardiology, diabetes, gynecology, gastroenterology, and anti-infective in the dosage forms of complex injectables and biologics, oral solids, liquids, topical products, and respiratory-metered dose inhaler, dry powder inhaler, and nasal sprays.
